validity.recommendation: Keep. Consider the spelling Bilche for the start.
validity.researcher_notes: Real line. The VTG design institute list and Ukrainian Wikipedia name it from Bilche-Volytsia to Dolyna, 68 km, 1400 mm, commissioned 1985. It links the Bilche-Volytsia storage to the Dolyna hub. It is not a duplicate of Ivatsevichy-Dolyna (P3484, P5938), which is a different line, or of Dolyna-Uzhhorod. It is a transmission-class 1400 mm line. Caveat: no operator document names it, and the name in the VTG list is the only line-level source for length.
